itemList.title: Well-known as People Who Work Abroad
itemList.desc: There are Filipinos all over the world from Europe to the Middle East, North America, and all across Asia. Filipino workers have been known to be hard-working, friendly, and loyal to their employers.

itemList.title: Low Average Age
itemList.desc: The average in the Philippines is around 25 years old, which means that there is a lot of youthful energy available for work.

itemList.title: English Speaking
itemList.desc: The demand for workers who are competent in the English language is growing with the rise of Globalization. The English language is especially important in the hotel and restaurant industry. Almost all Filipinos are proficient in English and are happy to share and utilize their skills.

itemList.title: Cost-effective High Quality Labor
itemList.desc: Although it may cost less to hire Filipino workers than locals, there will be no sacrifice in the quality of work. In fact, Filipinos who work abroad tend to work even harder than locals because of their feelings of gratitude and urgency to perform.

itemList.title: Low Minimum Wage
itemList.desc: The minimum wage in the Philippines is around $200 USD/month. This fact has driven Filipinos to find employment in foreign countries. They work extremely hard because they feel blessed to be earning higher wages abroad.

corporateIdentity.title: About Us
corporateIdentity.subtitle: Corporate Identity
corporateIdentity.placewellInternational: Placewell International is a Filipino-owned, family-run manpower agency with over 50 years of experience in deploying Filipino workers overseas. Headquartered in Makati and supported by more than 15 branches nationwide, we recruit, train, and deploy Filipino workers to companies all over the world. Placewell is committed to providing its clients with dependable workers and service that is efficient, organized and highly responsive. At the same time, Placewell remains dedicated to empowering Filipinos by connecting them with employers that value them as people.
corporateIdentity.chiefDesc: They are the husband and wife team that founded Placewell International and are pioneers in the Philippine overseas employment industry. Aida continues to provide dedicated service to her long-standing clients in the Middle East, even into her 90s.
corporateIdentity.viceDesc: Elo took over Placewell International in 1993 and has since transformed the company into one of the country’s leading manpower agencies. She is a seasoned businesswoman with a big heart. Under her leadership, Placewell has expanded its services across Europe, Asia, Oceania, and North America. She obtained her degree in Psychology from Colegio de San Juan de Letran.
corporateIdentity.consultantDesc: Joelo is a licensed attorney and a JLPT N1 passer. He obtained his degree in International Business from Pepperdine University and his Juris Doctor from Ateneo De Manila School of Law. He is also the President of Hashira Skills and Language Academy and Pro-Tech Skills Development Center Corporation. He has been with Placewell since 2018.
corporateIdentity.missionDesc: To be the most trusted, most reliable Philippine manpower services company in the world, recognized for readily available efficient services to our clients; for loyalty to our employees; for fidelity to our stockholders; and for social responsibility to our community.
corporateIdentity.visionDesc: A Philippine manpower services company, born of excellence, nurtured by expertise, and committed to leading in meeting the needs of global employers for highly competent, professional, and skilled Filipino workers.

corporatePhilosophy.line1: We are a people company that builds lasting relationships.
corporatePhilosophy.line2: We care for people because they are:

reasons.1: Filipino workers with dignity to be respected and rights to be protected.
reasons.3: Employees who need to be treated and rewarded fairly.

corporatePhilosophy.clientsDesc: We exist for our clients and, thus, work to provide them with on-time job-ready, and competent workers as required, by employing only ethical and modern recruitment practices and strategies that conform to international standards.
corporatePhilosophy.csrTitle: We take our corporate social responsibility seriously.
corporatePhilosophy.csrDesc: We share the rewards of business with the communities where we operate, believing that by giving freely, you shall receive tenfold.

ourServices.title: About Us
ourServices.subtitle: Our Services
ourServices.desc: From Skills and Language Training to Trade Tests – we do it all!
ourServices.recruitmentDesc: We source qualified workers through our network of over 15 branches nationwide, supported by a strong and active social media presence. In addition, our established reputation in the industry enables us to receive support from government agencies in identifying and recruiting highly qualified candidates.
ourServices.screeningDesc: We carefully screen candidates based on their work experience, qualifications, personality and English proficiency to ensure that our clients only interview qualified and outstanding workers
ourServices.interviewDesc: We have comfortable interview rooms and conduct interviews in an organized and professional manner. All applicants use a standard resume format for consistency. We also ensure that online interviews are conducted smoothly and with equally good quality.
ourServices.tradeTestDesc: We conduct trade tests across various industries at our own in-house facility.
ourServices.skillAndLangDesc: We have a dedicated school for Japanese language training, as well as separate facilities for Arabic and Cantonese language modules. In addition, we operate our own TESDA accredited training center.
ourServices.immigrationDesc: For OFW destinations requiring immigration interviews, such as Lithuania, we provide candidates with mock interview sessions where our staff simulate the role of immigration officers to help them prepare effectively.
ourServices.preDepartureDesc: An accredited provider since 1988, Placewell conducts the government-required Pre-Departure Orientation Seminar (PDOS) in its own facility. This one-day seminar prepares selected candidates by providing essential information about their destination country and useful advice about working abroad.
ourServices.deploymentDesc: We transport our workers to the airport, ensuring they arrive on time for their flights. Prior to departure, we orient them on all necessary airport procedures, both local and international.
ourServices.postDeploymentDesc: We have a dedicated OFW welfare division and a 24/7 call center to support workers who may experience distress while abroad.
ourServices.myraDesc: Myra is Placewell’s personalized manpower support system that ensures all selected workers’ relevant information and documents are properly organized, upholding an accurate and timely deployment process. It also maintains a readily available pool of candidates across various industries, with filters for quick and easy searching and sorting. Placewell also provides employers with their own personalized Myra accounts, offering customized features tailored to their specific industry needs.
ourServices.whatsAup: WhatsApp and Line Group Chat System
ourServices.whatsAupDesc: To ensure fast and efficient communication with all our partners and clients, we use a group chat system managed by our dedicated staff. We prioritize quick and accurate responses, recognizing the importance of time in the recruitment process.
ourServices.whatsAppGroupDesc: Instant messaging and updates for smooth communication
ourServices.lineGroupDesc: Organized group chats for better coordination and collaboration.
ourServices.facebookDesc: With nearly 500,000 Facebook followers, we generate hundreds of qualified applicants from a single post. Our dedicated manpower support team thoroughly screens every candidate before presenting them to clients — saving you time and ensuring only the best reach your interview table.

tradeTest.title: Our Services
tradeTest.subtitle: Trade Tests
tradeTest.desc: We conduct Trade Tests at our own facility
tradeTest.weldingDesc: We have our own dedicated facility for welding trade tests, equipped with 16 welding machines that can be used for MIG Welding and Stick Welding.
tradeTest.carpentryDesc: Our facility is complete with all tools and equipment needed to conduct a thorough evaluation of a carpenter’s skills
tradeTest.trailerDesc: We are partnered with a logistics company that has a spacious trucking yard and numerous trucks that are adjustable to the needs and requirements of our employers.
tradeTest.masonryDesc: Our facility is adequate enough to handle a basic masonry/plastering trade test
tradeTest.paintingDesc: We are able to conduct metal, drywall and cement wall at our trade test center.
tradeTest.scaffoldingDesc: Our facility is complete with equipment and safety gear to conduct scaffolding trade tests of up to 25 meters.
tradeTest.heavyDesc: We are partnered with a mining company that has a wide area that can be used for dump truck, excavator and bulldozer trade tests.
tradeTest.caregivingDesc: We have our own dedicated facility for training and trade tests and modeled up to modern Japanese nursing home standards.
tradeTest.foodDesc: Our facility is complete with tools and equipment needed to conduct training and trade tests for cooking, proper serving and hygiene management.
tradeTest.cleaningDesc: Our facility is complete with beds, dining tables, cooking tools and more – making it satisfactory for high-quality training and trade tests for domestic and hotel works.

branch.title: About Us
branch.subtitle: Branch Offices
branch.desc: With over 15 branches nationwide, Placewell has a strong presence in the Philippines and recruits workers from all over the country. Our branch offices are located in key cities and provinces, allowing us to connect with a wide pool of talented Filipino workers and provide them with the support they need throughout the recruitment and deployment process.

worldWide.subtitle: Worldwide Careers
worldWide.desc: Over 200,000 Filipinos deployed to more than 30 different countries
worldWide.constructionDesc: From construction sites to shipyards and highways, These skilled professionals build, operate, and maintain the structures and systems that keep the world moving forward.
worldWide.welderDesc:
We specialize in the recruitment

and training of welders across all

types of welding. We deploy skilled

welders to Saudi Arabia, Japan, Croatia

and Lithuania.
worldWide.shipyardDesc:
We have deployed over a thousand shipyard

workers to Japan, particularly in Imabari,

including placements at

Imabari Zosen and Shin Kurushima Dock.
worldWide.truckingDesc:
We implement a specialized recruitment

system for truck drivers bound for Lithuania.

We maintain a pool of pre-documented

candidates and conduct mock immigration

worldWide.hospitalityDesc: These professionals ensure people feel comportable, safe and cared for -whether at home, in hotels, on flights, or in the places where we gather and relax.
worldWide.cleardersDesc: Our highest-volume job order is the deployment of on-call cleaners to Saudi Arabia.
worldWide.domesticDesc: Placewell is recognized as a leading Philippine manpower agency for deploying domestic helpers to Hong Kong. We also deploy domestic helpers in the Middle East, Singapore, Malaysia, Mongolia, and Italy.

worldWide.flight: Flight Attendants and Ground Handling staff
worldWide.flightDesc: We are a provider of flight attendants and ground handling staff for Kuwait Airways.
worldWide.medicalDesc: These healthcare professionals provide essential medical care, support, and treatment -helping individuals live healthier, happier lives.
worldWide.nursesDesc: We have deployed numerous nurses to hospitals in Saudi Arabia, including the Ministry of National Guard Health Affairs and Saudi German Hospital.We have also placed hundreds of nurses in hospitals across the United States.
worldWide.caregiversDesc: We were among the first manpower agencies to deploy caregivers to Japan under the Technical Intern Training Program.We also deploy caregivers to Taiwan and SingaporeSaudi Arabia.

department.ofwDesc: Placewell prioritizes the welfare of its deployed workers through ongoing support and care. Our dedicated call center operates nearly 24/7 to promptly address concerns and provide assistance to distressed workers abroad.

dormitory.ExteriorDesc: Our centrally located facility offers modern, safe, and comfortable accommodations, able to accommodate 300+ residents. We prioritize community and support for a positive living experience.
dormitory.RoomsDesc: Our rooms are thoughtfully designed to provide a comfortable and restful living space. Each unit features secure storage, proper ventilation, and a clean, organized layout, with double-deck beds arranged to maximize space and privacy. We prioritize comfort, hygiene, and a sense of community in every room.
dormitory.CafeteriaDesc: Our cafeteria provides a clean and welcoming space where workers can enjoy their meals comfortably. With ample seating, good ventilation, and natural lighting, it's designed to accommodate large groups while maintaining a relaxed atmosphere. We prioritize cleanliness, proper food handling areas, and a space that encourages rest and community during meal times.
dormitory.LaundryDesc: Our laundry area provides workers with a convenient and well-maintained space to keep their belongings clean. Equipped with reliable washing facilities and designated drying areas, it's designed for easy access and efficient use. We prioritize cleanliness, proper organization, and a hassle-free laundry experience for all residents.
dormitory.RestroomsDesc: Our dormitory comfort room is designed to provide residents with a clean, safe, and well-maintained hygiene space. The facility is regularly cleaned and maintained to uphold high sanitation standards. We prioritize cleanliness, privacy, and convenience to ensure a comfortable living experience for all dormitory occupants.

history.Placewell: Placewell International was established in 1978 by husband and wife team Filemon and Aida Escueta. At the time, Placewell International was one of the first ten (10) manpower agencies that were given a license by the then POEA.
history.First: First Deployment to the Middle East
history.PlacewellInternational: Placewell International first started sending Filipino workers abroad in the 1980s to its various clients in the Middle East, predominantly to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
history.After: After many years of managing and operating the company, Aida Escueta entrusted her daughter, Eleonor Escueta with the company. Eleonor continues to lead Placewell International to this day.
history.FirstDeploymentDesc: Placewell International started sending Filipino workers to Hong Kong in the early 2000s and continues to do so to this day.
history.COMELECDesc: In the Philippines’ first automated election in 2010, Placewell International helped successfully mobilize 84,000 highly-skilled computer professionals as one of the 1,400 local and international manpower providers selected to man the COMELEC’s automated vote counting machines.
history.ISODesc: Through countless training sessions and audits with a reputable consultant, Placewell International was able to secure its ISO Certification.
history.MovedDesc: Placewell International was able to build and move into its own five-storey headquarters in Makati where it currently runs its operations.
history.EstablishmentProtechDesc: Pro-Tech Skills was established as Placewell International’s own TESDA-accredited training center with the goal of giving its candidates better training opportunities as cleaners, domestic helpers and caregivers.
history.FirstDeploymentJapanDesc: Placewell International started sending workers to Japan in 2018 under the Technical Intern Training Program (TITP).
history.EstablishmentHashiraDesc: Hashira Skills was established in 2020 as a stay-in Japanese language school to fulfill the language training requirements of Japanese employers. Hashira Skills is also TESDA-accredited in numerous construction-based courses.
history.FirstEuropeDesc: Placewell International started deploying skilled workers to European countries such as Croatia, Slovenia, Italy, Lithuania and more in 2023. Over the next years, the company quickly gained popularity among Filipino applicants who aspire to work in Europe.

competitive.title: About Us
competitive.subtitle: Competitive Advantages
competitive.Discover: Discover what makes Placewell International a trusted recruitment partner across multiple global markets.
competitive.SaudiDesc: We have a large worker pool and fast processing times because of our good track record and strong relationship with the DMW and Embassy of Saudi Arabia.
competitive.JapanDesc: In our affiliated Japanese school, we recruit, screen and train workers before lining them up for interviews. Thanks to this system, our clients are able to interview candidates who are already JFT A2 passers or JLPT N4 passers.
competitive.EuropeDesc: We have a pool of workers who are already screened for English proficiency and are actively gathering their required documents, making the process for deployment much faster and more efficient.
competitive.HongDesc: Our Myra system has well-made videos of hundreds of highly qualified domestic helpers who are available for reservation with just the click of a button.
